description: Create a small archive from inline text entries. Reproducible by default: canonical entry order (raw UTF-8 name bytes), DOS-epoch timestamps, UTF-8 names. The archive comes back once as an embedded resource block (data:application/zip;base64,...); structuredContent carries { mode, sizeBytes, summary, diagnostics }.
